train_model: train a ResNet-18 model on CIFAR-10 with a given optimizer and loss criterion
test_model: test a trained PyTorch model on CIFAR-10 and return classification accuracy
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU training of ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10 using NCCL backend
configure_training_flags: configure training flags for epochs, batch size, learning rate, and momentum via absl
download_cifar10_dataset: download CIFAR-10 training and test datasets to specified directories
